If you would like to know – can you get tinted windows for your house? The answer is yes!

Tinting your home windows gives you privacy and also creates a more comfortable temperature all year round for you and your family. Below is information on how you can tint home windows and the benefits of having tinted windows for your home. Tint a Home specialises in home window tinting and has been providing tinting services in Australia for over 40 years. We are Australia’s most trusted window tinting network so you’re in good hands! Read on to find out more about whether you can tint house windows.

Can You Tint Home Windows To Reduce Heat In Your Home?

Yes, you can! Our Heat and Glare Solar Film is specifically designed to reduce the heat and glare entering your home to provide year-round comfort. The benefits of our Heat and Glare Solar Film include:

  • Privacy
  • Your home will be cooler in the summer months and cosier through winter
  • You’ll notice a positive difference in your power bills
  • A reduction in UV wear and tear on your carpets, floorboards & furniture
  • Protection for you and your family from the damage caused by UV rays

Can You Tint Your House Windows Without Losing Your View?

Many people ask ‘can you tint your house windows without losing your view?’ You absolutely can have your home windows tinted without it hindering your view. We have a range of privacy films that ensure privacy during the day without losing natural light in your home or hindering your view – ideal for windows that are street facing, overlooking a neighbour or for bathroom windows. Our privacy films also help to regulate temperature all year round too, which you’ll notice in your power bills!

Can You Tint House Windows To Keep Your Family Safe?

There are many benefits to tinting your home windows but knowing you can tint house windows to protect your family is one of the most important. Our Security Film is 10 times thicker than standard film and helps to prevent break-ins. If a window is hit with force it keeps the shattered glass in place, slowing access for unwanted visitors into your home.

Call 13TINT to speak with our friendly customer service team about how you can tint house windows today.
